Movie and series platforms

Streaming services familiar to US viewers

These are popular places people watch films, shows and live TV. Their services require their own access and are not included with IPTV4USA plans.

  • NetflixOn-demand films, series and originals.
  • Prime VideoAmazon movies, series and live events.
  • Disney+Disney, Pixar, Marvel and more.
  • HuluSeries, films and original programming.
  • HBO MaxFilms, HBO series and originals.
  • PeacockNBCUniversal shows, movies and sports.
  • Paramount+Paramount films, series and live content.
  • Apple TVApple original movies and series.
  • ESPN+Sports streaming and on-demand events.
  • YouTube TVLive TV streaming service.
  • Sling TVFlexible live TV streaming plans.
  • TubiFree ad-supported films and shows.
  • Pluto TVFree ad-supported live channels and films.
  • The Roku ChannelFree movies, series and live channels.
